name: brand-spoof-leadgen
description: Modelled on a real lead-generation spoof. Sender name asserts a financial brand ('Northwind Life Offer') that is not in the brand table, from an unrelated random domain, with a repeated-fragment local part, an evasion-formatted subject, and every link plain HTTP to the same unknown host. Nothing here is brand-list-dependent, which is the point: identity.unsupported_org_claim has to catch it without the table. Also carries the two pre-normalisation signals: randomised address case and a padded subject, both of which the adapter's normalisation would otherwise erase. Recipient, brand and domain invented; body paraphrased; sender, subject and link shape as observed.
